cards.name: Bedsure Heated Blanket Electric Throw (50 x 60 in)
cards.badge: Product of the day · the value pick in heated throws
cards.price: Heated throws run about $20 to $80 at major retailers; Walmart listed the U by Bedsure 50×60 throw at about $32 on October 1, 2026. The button shows today's price.
cards.buy_if: you want one person on a sofa or desk warm for about a cent or two an hour, and you will check the model number on the label before first use.
cards.skip_if: you want to cover a bed or share the blanket (50×60 in is too small; look at a queen or full-size electric blanket) or you want a product with no recall history to explain.
cards.owners: Walmart's review summary for the U by Bedsure 50×60 throw (seen in search results, undated) praises quick heat and softness. Owners fault heating zones that quit after months and controller errors.

buy.pick: The 50×60 throw with Preheat and the 8-hour auto-off (the listing title says so); the 3-hour auto-off versions suit lounging only
buy.check: Sold by Bedsure or Amazon.com; ETL mark in the title; then read the model number on the label and compare it with the 2023 CPSC recall list (BS-HB5060 is on it) before you plug it in
